findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed support is the learning window [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity target is observable and all coordinate contrasts are relative, not absolute geometric or energetic descriptors.

Continuous contrast functions over the complete observed window show sign changes and strong sign conflicts for landmark local coordinate features (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_cxy has 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts), and no polynomial fit is accepted (polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false), so a constant rule is not supported and time-conditioned behavior is only descriptive within the observed nodes.

Joint diagnostics show a coherent teacher-contrast pattern: teacher_contrast_coherence whole-window mean is high with a positive batch fraction of 1.0, and teacher_contrast_RMS_A is positive across all batches, indicating coupled joint coordinate structure rather than isolated marginal descriptors.

The only null-tested joint diagnostic with a positive association is selection_innovation/innovation_native_alignment (p and q near 1e-9, positive batch fraction 1.0), whereas observed_child_score_gain is significantly negative (positive batch fraction 0.0), so immediate selection evidence and available descendant score credit disagree in sign.

Several joint diagnostics (innovation_RMS_A, teacher_contrast_RMS_A, teacher_contrast_coherence, teacher_control_root_ESS, teacher_score_gap, teacher_noise_RMS_A) are explicitly descriptive within-selector associations with null_tested false and no p/q, so they cannot be ranked as multiplicity-adjusted support and are not causal selection effects.

hypotheses.falsifier: the time-conditioned rule shows no reduction in sign conflicts or fit error relative to the constant rule on the observed nodes
hypotheses.observable: sign changes and strong sign conflicts of landmark local coordinate contrast functions over the observed window
hypotheses.scope: observed score nodes within [0.0,0.5], no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast at observed selection nodes, using the validated absolute contrast change rather than a constant rule, will track the observed sign-changing landmark local coordinate trends better than a constant contrast rule.

hypotheses.direction: joint coherent pattern over isolated marginals
hypotheses.falsifier: joint coherence shows no positive batch fraction or no separation from marginal descriptors
hypotheses.scope: within-selector descriptive association, batch as independent unit
hypotheses.statement: Joint coherent teacher-contrast structure carries information beyond isolated marginal coordinate descriptors, so a joint-pattern reward should be preferred over marginal-only descriptors.

hypotheses.direction: treat disagreement as a direction-priority caveat, not as final affinity benefit
hypotheses.falsifier: the two quantities agree in sign under the same independent-batch accounting
hypotheses.scope: within-selector association; no decoded terminal labels available
hypotheses.statement: Immediate selection innovation alignment and later observed child score gain disagree in sign, so direction priorities should not treat last-record or immediate selection credit as final affinity benefit.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit and the immediate-versus-descendant comparison remains unavailable.
Recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies; no absolute affinity or physical interaction energy is observable from the supplied evidence.
Most joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations with null_tested false and no p/q, so multiplicity-adjusted ranking is not possible for them.
Continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed and no accepted polynomial, so time-conditioned behavior is descriptive only within the observed window.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst, so no causal selection effect, atom velocity, or neural-module causation can be claimed.
